device_state_machine.init_sequence: CMD0 (Idle) -> CMD1 poll OCR (Ready) -> CMD2 CID (Ident) -> CMD3 RCA (Stand-by)
device_state_machine.transfer_sequence: CMD7 select (Stby->Tran) -> read/write block commands cycle Tran<->Data/Rcv<->Prg
device_state_machine.reset: RST_n hardware reset or CMD0 returns the device to Idle

partition_switch_fsm: PARTITION_CONFIG.PARTITION_ACCESS (via SWITCH/CMD6) routes subsequent User-area accesses to the selected partition (User / Boot1 / Boot2 / RPMB / GPP1..4).
boot_fsm: power-up/RST_n -> (boot mode: CMD held low >=74 clk, or alternative boot CMD0 arg 0xFFFFFFFA) -> stream boot partition -> terminate -> normal identification.
